record_type: ONS release-calendar metadata observations for H1 section 3 timestamp invariance
method: Official ONS release calendar pages loaded in a browser; titles, release dates, release status and result counts were extracted programmatically. Direct scripted requests returned HTTP 403, so page SHA-256 values are of the rendered HTML text. No bulletin, dataset, time series or GDP value was opened or inspected.
